slides.texte_overlay:
How to sell yourself to
absolutely everyone

The first-minute rule -

Name, handshake, one sentence
about what you do well.

The proof rule -

Show one result.
It beats ten promises.

The curiosity rule -

Ask about them first.
People buy from people who care.

The care rule -

Clean shoes, pressed shirt.
Details speak first.

The substance rule -

Know your field and the world
around it. Learn daily.
slides.texte_sophia:
The substance rule -

I learn a little every day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
The follow-up rule -

A message the next day.
Most people never send it.
